clue.text: Acquisition of tea-bag?

indicators.note: read 'tea-bag' as a bag made of tea, the tea sitting inside the bag

parts.note: a purse is a small bag for money
cha is slang for tea

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about what a teabag counts as when you get one.
explanation.walkthrough: There is no container signal word: the hyphenated 'tea-bag' is read literally as a bag holding tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something bought or obtained is an acquisition, a thing purchased.

clue.text: Cramped page fine when article deleted

indicators.note: deleted tells us the article named just before it is struck out of the word for fine

parts.note: fine, as in all right, is okay
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a cramped page and a fine for dropping an article.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a poky room is small and confined, uncomfortably tight.

clue.text: Don't start to scrape skin

indicators.note: an instruction to leave off the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: to grind is to scrape or rub harshly

explanation.surface: A warning not to begin scraping someone's skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the peel or tough outer layer of fruit or cheese is its skin.

clue.text: Rashly, teacher overlooks best class

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece that overlooks another sits above it, so comes first

parts.note: the head is the head teacher of a school
a first is the best class of degree at a British university

explanation.surface: A teacher recklessly ignores the top class.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'overlooks' puts HEAD above FIRST. A first is the top grade of a British honours degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: doing something headlong, without forethought, is acting recklessly.

clue.text: Cut corners, or another reason for fast lap times?

definitions.meaning: to take a shortcut, bypassing the proper procedure

definitions.text: another reason for fast lap times?
definitions.meaning: a race track that is short would give quick laps, a whimsical second sense

explanation.surface: A racing driver's excuse for quick laps: either cheating at the corners or a shorter track.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to bypass a process is to cut corners; and literally a brief racing course makes laps quicker.

clue.text: Frisk criminal mob arrested by girl

indicators.note: arrested means held, so the girl word holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: gal is an informal word for girl

indicators.note: criminal as an anagram signal: the letters of mob behave lawlessly and rearrange

explanation.surface: Police frisk a criminal gang that a girl has arrested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges the three letters of 'mob' to MBO; 'Frisk' is a verb meaning skip about, not search.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to frisk is to skip and leap playfully, as lambs do.

clue.text: Maltreat one carrying passengers into A&E

indicators.note: into says the passenger carrier is put inside the A&E letters

parts.note: the letters A and E as written, the ampersand dropped
a bus is a vehicle carrying passengers

explanation.surface: Someone mistreats a passenger carrier by driving it into the hospital casualty unit.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is the British hospital emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to abuse someone is to treat them cruelly or badly.

clue.text: Badly situated for money, opening sparse menu

indicators.note: the sparse word opens up to let the other phrase in

parts.note: bare means sparse or scantily furnished
ill off means poorly provided for, badly off

explanation.surface: Someone short of cash opens a meagre menu.
explanation.walkthrough: 'opening' puts ILL OFF inside BARE: B-ILL OFF-ARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a bill of fare is an old phrase for a restaurant's list of dishes.

clue.text: Astonishing tightrope performer, one accompanied by country music?

definitions.meaning: taken literally, a performer who dances on a line or rope
someone dancing in rows to country and western songs

explanation.surface: An amazing high-wire act, perhaps set to country music.
explanation.definitionFit: Literal sense: a wire walker dancing on a rope; usual sense: a dancer in rows at a country music night.

clue.text: American native family at Oxford University secures three honours

parts.note: kin are family
in bridge the honour cards include king, ace and jack, K, A and J

explanation.surface: A Native American family at Oxford wins three honours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'American native' is an animal, not a person. The honours are bridge cards: king, ace, jack.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the kinkajou is a tree-dwelling mammal native to Central and South America.

clue.text: City expandin' considerably, nothing overlooked

indicators.note: overlooked means missed out, so the zero is left out

parts.note: doubling means expanding considerably, and the dropped g of 'expandin'' drops its final letter too
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A city growing fast, with nothing ignored.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in 'expandin'' signals the dropped final G.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the capital of the Republic of Ireland is a city.

clue.text: Familiar people, very smelly, in the Pyramid perhaps

parts.note: regulars are familiar faces, habitual customers
olid is a rare word for strongly foul-smelling

explanation.surface: Familiar folk reeking badly inside a pyramid, perhaps a nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tetrahedron, a pyramid with equal triangular faces, is one of the five Platonic polyhedra.

clue.text: Wrong time to present my daughter; in a minute? No

parts.note: off means wrong or not right, as milk goes off
here means present, in attendance
cor is an exclamation of surprise, like 'my!'

explanation.surface: An awkward moment to introduce my daughter, a parent thinks, before declining to wait a minute.
explanation.walkthrough: COR is a British exclamation like 'my!'. 'minute' is the official note of a meeting, not sixty seconds.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: remarks not for publication are not entered in the minutes of a meeting.

clue.text: New certificate being received by awful duet is unexpected

indicators.note: being received means taken in, so the new certificate goes inside the other piece
awful signals an anagram, the duet's letters made a mess of

parts.note: scrip is a certificate of entitlement to shares

explanation.surface: A dreadful duo greet a new certificate with surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' turns DUET into UTED; NSCRIP goes inside after the U.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something not written beforehand is improvised, so arriving unforeseen.

clue.text: Notice no women finally expect change

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement
just men means only males, so no women

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word expect

explanation.surface: A warning that, without women, change can at last be expected.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an alteration or small modification is a change.

clue.text: In pouring rain, died in the pits

indicators.note: In places the death abbreviation inside the reworked rain
rain that is pouring is tumbling about, an anagram signal

explanation.surface: Miners perished in torrential rain down in the pits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pouring' rearranges 'rain' to NAIR, and 'In' sets the death abbreviation after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: the pits is the very worst point, the lowest ebb.

clue.text: Drug may make one burp, if chewed

indicators.note: chewed means mangled in the mouth, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A painkiller tablet may make you belch if you chew it.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a common anti-inflammatory painkiller is a drug.

clue.text: Reactor requiring Greens regularly to think

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of Greens

parts.note: to ponder is to think carefully

explanation.surface: Environmentalists periodically consider a nuclear reactor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the 2nd, 4th and 6th letters of GREENS, giving RES.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who replies or reacts to something is a reactor.

clue.text: Some bread excellent with a class of seafood

parts.note: a crust is part of a loaf
ace means excellent

explanation.surface: A seafood platter with bread, rated excellent.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: crabs, lobsters and shrimps belong to this biological group of shellfish.

clue.text: Short layer of concrete and loose stone

indicators.note: short means cut, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a screed is a levelling layer of concrete or mortar

explanation.surface: A builder lays a short concrete layer and some stones.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a mass of loose rock fragments on a mountain slope is scree.

clue.text: Break during school time is heaven

parts.note: in means during
a term is a period of the school year
Sion, or Zion, is heaven, the holy city

explanation.surface: A pupil says playtime during school is heavenly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an interval in a play or film is a break.

clue.text: Having second thoughts about taking one step outside

indicators.note: outside says the step word sits round the one

parts.note: a rung is a step on a ladder
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone reconsidering whether to go outside for a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: regretting something means having second thoughts about it.

clue.text: A very brief book

indicators.note: brief means cut short, so the last letter goes

parts.note: most means very, as in 'most kind'

explanation.surface: A book that is very short.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of the minor prophets gives his name to a book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Become strained in conflict

definitions.meaning: nerves or tempers ... when they wear thin under strain
a fight or brawl, as in joining the fight

explanation.surface: Tempers become stretched in a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: to wear thin under tension, and a noisy quarrel or battle.

clue.text: Some letters in Greek, with one for a nymph

indicators.note: one for a means the numeral replaces the letter a

parts.note: thetas are letters of the Greek alphabet
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Greek letters, plus one, spell a nymph's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: in Greek myth, the sea nymph who was mother of Achilles.

clue.text: Russian boy I note in the Queen Vic?

indicators.note: in places the boy, I and the note inside the queen's cipher

parts.note: VR, Victoria Regina, is Queen Victoria's royal cipher
a lad is a boy
mi is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A Russian lad drinking in the Queen Vic, the pub in the TV soap EastEnders.
explanation.walkthrough: The Queen Vic is the pub in EastEnders, but here it is Queen Victoria, VR.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Vladimir is a typical Russian man's name, as in Putin or Lenin.

clue.text: Timid creature fitted with tracker for period of twilight

indicators.note: fitted with means given, so the tracker goes inside the creature

parts.note: a doe, a female deer, is a shy creature
a tag is an electronic tracking device

explanation.surface: A shy deer wearing a tracking collar in the dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: Metaphor: the twilight of life is old age, when the mind may weaken.

clue.text: One would think I had always put across God

indicators.note: put across means placed so as to span, the god sitting between the other letters

parts.note: I'd is a contraction of I had
ay, or aye, means always
Ares is the Greek god of war

explanation.surface: Someone thinks they always conveyed God across.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: 'I suppose' or 'probably' is a way of saying it seems likely.
